items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I know he's, I know, I'm telling you now, I was affiliated with some of his relatives.

ctx.x: 92. I got to know him. He quit playing by 1918, 1917. Yeah. Where did everybody at?
Shane's on the Legion field. I'm sure you heard him when you were coming up. Jack Lane? Yeah. Papa Jack, Papa Lane.

Oh yeah, sure. I know he's, I know, I'm telling you now, I was affiliated with some of his relatives. Sure, they got machines on the Legion field and the Legion field between Charters and Decatur. Right at the corner, Dicky Potato Chips.
